title: Mean of a hypercontractive variable
statement: Let $\\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $p,q>0$ be real numbers, let $\\rho<1$, and let $X:\\Omega\\to\\mathbb R$. Suppose that for every $a,b\\in\\mathbb R$, the uniform $L^q$ norm of $a+\\rho bX$ is at most the uniform $L^p$ norm of $a+bX$. Then the mean of $X$ on $\\Omega$ is zero. Here the uniform norms are taken with respect to the uniform distribution on $\\Omega$.
hypotheses_covered: the stated affine norm inequality holds for all real $a,b$
